name: code-quality
description: Code quality and review for production systems. Bundles a strict distributed-systems code reviewer (PRs, diffs, plans) with a disciplined BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/QUESTION severity model, TypeScript quality patterns (typed clients, Zod validation, structured errors, no-any, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, PII redaction), and a GitHub PR review poster that maps those severities to review events and inline anchors. The official-tier home for the marketplace's code-review and code-quality skills (ADR-0008 group 6).
